stops.note: described the method of marinating and stewing meat or fish in an onion sauce
stops.meaning: to cook in an onion sauce

stops.note: entered English through Senegalese restaurants and cookbooks describing the dish
stops.meaning: a Senegalese dish of marinated, onion-stewed chicken or fish

current_meaning: a Senegalese dish of chicken or fish marinated and stewed in onions, lemon, and mustard
